headline: Mercy and Mooring Flare As Berm Fighting Pauses
war_summary: The wires since midnight tell a shifted tale, with Linn Mercy now the liveliest sector counting five changes in two hours and eleven in the day about Outwich Ranch, standing one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral, with two-hour losses near sixteen hundred Colonial and twenty-four hundred Warden and the latest flip at 02:21. Mooring County has stirred anew with three changes in the last two hours and thirty-five in the day about MacConmara Barrows and the Wind Hills, now listed twelve Warden after the late wire at the same hour. Palantine Berm and Marban Hollow have fallen silent in the last two hours after thirteen in six hours and twenty-two in the day and four in six hours and twenty in the day respectively, the former about Windburn Landing and the Pippeli Stones at two Warden and five Colonial, the latter centred on Checkpoint Bua at three Warden, four Colonial and one neutral. Weathered Expanse remains quiet at six hours despite forty-six changes in the day about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, as does Nevish Line in the last two hours after three in six hours about Grief Mother amid very heavy day losses. Callahan's Passage reports sharp losses without a recorded flip, and Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf show no fresh movement.
